name: merged-screenshot-evidence
goal: Keep source-identical merged screenshots visible with honest original provenance and verify main after landing

steps.title: Identify the regression, prior working behavior, root cause, and evidence.
steps.evidence: Main 0816efe and parent 27763e8 have zero attached records or focused captures. PR20 proof belongs to 4843a73b and is not in prepared main history; PR31 handoff accepted empty thumbnails. Squash landing creates a distinct commit despite an identical source tree.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the regression; name the coverage gap and reusable test or shared guard change.
steps.evidence: Existing standardized loop/history tests rebuild only the feature fix commit. Add a source-identical sibling squash revision and a changed-tree rejection; extend the shared evidence selection suite to assert retained origin without a current/full-verification verdict.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Corrected readiness checkpoint f25505fc938cfc39b7097f5790f20dc52bf904fd fails source-identical squash in the unchanged standardized history matrix. Details captures now wait for their actual Contract tab rather than an absent Performance panel.

steps.title: Propose a root-cause repair and an automated guard for the identified failure.
steps.evidence: Retain sealed original captures only across identical complete Git trees; preserve original commit/build and focused status; reject changed trees and verify delivered main after landing.

steps.title: Implement the repair and wire the prevention test or guard into normal project verification.
steps.evidence: History and shared projections retain source-identical focused evidence with original provenance. Generated/local guidance requires post-merge decoding; failed green diagnostics now retain the command output in the error.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Immutable corrected green 15c910636053711aaa46c7f732fe05f82372b09d109b2fb9a09d3773ea34f68a at f0d6a762d31de8c227c26d89d2e92ae185c72576 passes unchanged tests and all 50 Explorer browser cases, retaining 217 images and 1086 observations.

steps.title: In an isolated fixture or temporary workspace, prove reintroducing the original failure makes the guard fail; restore and prove it passes.
steps.evidence: Isolated f0d6a762 snapshot with original selector fails source-identical squash displays original screenshot; restored selector passes 12 tests. Guard outputs retained in .cache/harness/merged-screenshots.

steps.title: Repeat until the guard and relevant project checks pass; verify affected UI flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending while proof fails.
